_comment: Each scenario: level (which parts and materials are unlocked, and the build points: unlocks.json), budget (credits for the whole ship), allow (catalogue categories it may use; default all), the hits it takes (incoming: damage a hit, its pen and type, damage per second, where from: front, rear, sides, left, right or all, the spread in degrees, and flank: the share of hits that come from any side instead), and how it is scored. weights: each measure against the starting ship's (1 = as good as the start). targets: a measure worth its weight once it reaches the target and no more (thrust_to_mass: shipgen's roles use 0.06 for haulers and capitals up to 0.2 for a starter). penalties: per count. Measures: damage_before_down, systems_kept (firepower, thrust and power still working, over the seconds it lasts), alive_s, half_s, sustained_dps, burst_dps, thrust_to_mass, engine_zone (engines in the last rows, zones of 3), cargo. Penalties: unpowered (guns, engines, shields under a quarter of their power), idle (relays and reactors nothing goes through), blocked (guns with outline in front, engines with outline behind), no_engines (1 when no engine works), parts. shape: {margin}: how many cells beyond the outline it may build (0: the outline exactly). More penalties: shape_off (cells where the ship and the outline differ). A target with gate: true scales the whole score by 0.3 + 0.7 × how far it is met instead of adding to it (its weight is unused). invalid: per validator error (the ship may pass through invalid states on the way to valid ones).

scenarios.name: Gunship: head-on fight
scenarios.about: Fights facing the enemy: most hits come at the nose. Scored on damage dealt before going down.

scenarios.name: Brawler: surrounded
scenarios.about: Hit from every side. Survival matters as much as damage.

scenarios.name: Hauler: get the cargo home
scenarios.about: Carries as much as it can, fast, and survives being chased (hits from behind).
